markets.title: 1X2 - 1UP
markets.guide: Which team will win the match. If your team leads by 1 goal at any time, it will be considered a winner. Regular time only. *** Example: *** Bet on Home. The bet wins if Home wins but will be paid out early if Home leads by 1 goal at any time. *** Bet on Draw. The bet wins if the match ends in a Draw. *** Bet on Away. The bet wins if Away wins but will be paid out early if Away leads by 1 goal at any time.

markets.title: 1X2 - 2UP
markets.guide: Which team will win the match. If your team leads by 2 goals at any time, it will be considered a winner. Regular time only. *** Example: *** Bet on Home. The bet wins if Home wins but will be paid out early if Home leads by 2 goals at any time. *** Bet on Draw. The bet wins if the match ends in a Draw. *** Bet on Away. The bet wins if Away wins but will be paid out early if Away leads by 2 goals at any time.
